title: Settings
currenciesHint: Add any currency and configure its denominations. Historical currencies stay available as inactive records.
noDenominations: No denominations yet. Add note and coin values for teller counting.
denominationInUse: This denomination has history and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{code}}? Historical transactions are kept, but it will be hidden from new transactions.
deleteConfirm: Permanently remove {{code}}? This is allowed only because it has no historical transactions.
deleteBlocked: {{code}} has historical transactions, so it cannot be permanently deleted. You can deactivate it instead. Existing transactions will not be changed.
passwordHint: Use 8 to 128 characters. After a successful change you will need to sign in again.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Please sign in again.
recoveryHint: The answer is stored as a secure hash. It is not shown again after saving.
recoveryMissing: A security hint is not configured yet. Set one so you can recover access if you forget the password.
companySetupHint: Enter your company information. You can change it later in Settings.
logoHint: JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Maximum 5 MB.
exchangeHint: When enabled, a calculator appears on the main page. Rates are entered manually and are not fetched from the internet.

updates.title: Application updates
updates.readyHint: Update downloaded. A validated safety backup will be created before installation.
updates.unsupportedHint: In-app updates are available in the installed Windows build. Development mode does not download releases.

states.ready: Update downloaded and ready to install.

errors.generic: The update could not be completed.
errors.checkFailed: Could not check for updates. You can keep using FMT offline.
errors.downloadFailed: Download failed. Your current installation was not changed.
errors.backupFailed: Update was not installed because the safety backup could not be completed.
errors.unsupported: Updates are not available in this environment.
errors.notAvailable: No update is available to download.
errors.invalidVersion: The update server returned an invalid version.
